extractions.value: Paraneoplastic SPS associated with thymoma type B3. Tonic eye deviation, impaired smooth pursuit, and poor saccade initiation are rare ocular manifestations.
extractions.quote: This report expands the spectrum of clinical findings in SPS to include tonic eye deviation, impaired smooth pursuit, and poor saccade initiation.
